title: Dashing Through the Kitchen Pickleball Sweatshirt, Funny Christmas Pickleball Crewneck, Reindeer Pickleball Gift
description:
Dashing through the kitchen... every pickleball player knows you're not supposed to. Our reindeer pickleball does it anyway.

Who it's for:
- Pickleball players who get called for kitchen faults (or call them)
- Christmas, Secret Santa and stocking-stuffer shoppers
- Holiday round robins and club parties

About the design:
A retro cartoon pickleball with antlers and a red nose sprints with a paddle, motion lines and snow puffs behind it, between 'Dashing' and 'Kitchen' lettering with a 'through the' ribbon. Screen-print style colours with a subtle worn texture.

Soft, cozy unisex crewneck sweatshirt. Size up for an oversized fit.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
